barriers.pre_state: v0.3.20 SQLite state store present at the legacy runtime data path; no 0.4 backup directory exists
barriers.post_state: byte-identical backup of the legacy store written and fsync'd under the 0.4 runtime data dir before any schema write
barriers.failure_injection: crash after the backup file is created but before its fsync/rename completes
barriers.expected_failure_state: legacy store untouched; partial backup is discarded on next start and re-created
barriers.rollback_assertion: restored backup hash equals the recorded pre-migration store hash and v0.3.20 opens it

barriers.component: vz-stack state store legacy -> topology migration
barriers.pre_state: legacy sandbox tables only; no topology tables; user_version below the topology schema
barriers.post_state: topology tables created in one transaction with no project rows yet
barriers.failure_injection: abort after the topology schema DDL commits and before the first project write
barriers.expected_failure_state: topology tables exist and are empty; legacy tables unchanged; migration resumes idempotently
barriers.rollback_assertion: restoring the backup removes the topology tables and v0.3.20 reads the legacy tables

barriers.component: vz-stack state store legacy -> topology migration
barriers.pre_state: topology schema exists; zero migrated Project/Environment/Machine rows
barriers.post_state: one Project, Environment, Machine and WorkspaceBinding row per migrated legacy Developer sandbox with legacy_sandbox_id UNIQUE and LegacyMigrationProvenance{source_version=v0.3.20}
barriers.failure_injection: abort after the first project write with further legacy sandboxes pending
barriers.expected_failure_state: the written project is complete and consistent; remaining sandboxes still classified as pending; re-run migrates only the remainder
barriers.rollback_assertion: restoring the backup leaves no project rows and every legacy sandbox record intact

barriers.pre_state: legacy Sandbox records carry Developer marker, Hardened space-mode label, or neither
barriers.post_state: Developer records become Developer-profile Machines; Hardened/generic records keep their profile from provenance; ambiguous or non-arm64 records are rejected with LegacyMigrationError and left untouched
barriers.failure_injection: inject a record carrying both Developer and Hardened markers, and a LinuxFirecracker/Other backend record
barriers.expected_failure_state: migration reports AmbiguousClassification/UnresolvedTargetArchitecture for those records, writes nothing for them, and migrates the others
barriers.rollback_assertion: no Hardened or generic record is ever converted into Developer; rejected records are byte-identical after rollback

barriers.component: vz-stack state store topology v3 migration
barriers.pre_state: topology rows lack v3 ownership columns/indexes
barriers.post_state: ownership rows rebuilt so every Machine, disk and Docker context has exactly one owning Environment
barriers.failure_injection: abort after ownership rebuild and before the lifecycle schema is created
barriers.expected_failure_state: ownership rows complete; lifecycle schema absent; user_version unchanged; migration resumes
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore drops ownership rows; no resource has two owners at any observable point

barriers.component: vz-stack state store topology v3 migration
barriers.pre_state: ownership rebuilt; no lifecycle operation tables
barriers.post_state: lifecycle operation tables created; user_version advanced to 3
barriers.failure_injection: abort inside the lifecycle DDL transaction
barriers.expected_failure_state: transaction rolled back; ownership rows remain; user_version still 2
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore returns user_version to the legacy value

barriers.component: vz-stack state store stack journal v4 migration
barriers.failure_injection: abort after journal DDL and before user_version update
barriers.expected_failure_state: journal tables present and empty or absent; user_version 3; migration is idempotent
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore has no journal tables

barriers.component: vz-stack state store replica v5 migration
barriers.pre_state: user_version 4; durable action rows in the pre-replica shape
barriers.post_state: durable action rows rebuilt with replica identity
barriers.failure_injection: abort after durable actions are rebuilt and before observed state is rebuilt
barriers.expected_failure_state: durable actions in v5 shape, observed state still v4, user_version 4; resume completes
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore returns durable actions to the v4 shape

barriers.component: vz-stack state store replica v5 migration
barriers.pre_state: durable actions rebuilt; observed state in the v4 shape
barriers.post_state: observed state rebuilt per replica; user_version 5
barriers.failure_injection: abort after observed state rebuild and before user_version update
barriers.expected_failure_state: both tables in v5 shape; user_version 4; re-run detects the completed shape and only bumps the version
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore has v4 observed state

barriers.component: vz-stack state store reconcile v6 migration
barriers.post_state: terminal history archived to its own table
barriers.failure_injection: abort after archival and before durable actions are rebuilt
barriers.expected_failure_state: archive table populated; source rows retained; no double archival on resume
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore has no archive table and complete inline history

barriers.component: vz-stack state store reconcile v6 migration
barriers.pre_state: terminal history archived; durable actions in v5 shape
barriers.post_state: durable actions rebuilt in reconcile-aware v6 shape
barriers.failure_injection: abort after the rebuild and before the replica claim index is created
barriers.expected_failure_state: v6 durable actions without claim index; user_version 5; resume creates only the index
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore returns v5 durable actions

barriers.component: vz-stack state store reconcile v6 migration
barriers.pre_state: v6 durable actions without the replica claim index
barriers.failure_injection: abort after index creation and before user_version update
barriers.expected_failure_state: index present; user_version 5; resume bumps the version only
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore has no claim index

barriers.component: vz-stack state store claim v7 migration
barriers.post_state: immutability triggers/guards created over claim rows; user_version 7
barriers.failure_injection: abort after guards are created and before user_version update
barriers.expected_failure_state: guards present and enforcing; user_version 6; resume is idempotent
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore has no guards and v0.3.20-era rows are unchanged

barriers.component: vz-stack state store teardown finalizer v8 migration
barriers.post_state: teardown finalizer tables created; user_version 8, then validated as the current v9 shape by validate_v9_schema
barriers.failure_injection: abort after finalizer DDL and before user_version update
barriers.expected_failure_state: finalizer tables present and empty; user_version 7; resume bumps the version
barriers.rollback_assertion: backup restore has no finalizer tables

barriers.pre_state: legacy sandboxes/<sandbox_id>/fs checkpoint directories exist under the runtime data dir
barriers.post_state: each legacy directory moved under checkpoints/legacy-artifacts/<timestamp>/<sandbox_id>-fs[-n] and a LegacyCheckpointMigrationReport recorded in the state store
barriers.failure_injection: crash after some directories are moved and before the report row is recorded
barriers.expected_failure_state: moved directories retained under the archive root; remaining legacy directories intact; next start archives the remainder into a new timestamped root and records both
barriers.rollback_assertion: restoring the archived directories to their legacy paths yields the pre-migration tree hash

barriers.pre_state: no vz-managed Docker context exists for the migrated Machine in the isolated VZ_DOCKER_CONFIG
barriers.post_state: exactly one managed context per Developer Linux Machine, recorded in the state store with Machine ownership; Hardened Machines have none
barriers.failure_injection: crash after the context metadata is written to the Docker config dir and before the ownership row commits
barriers.expected_failure_state: orphan context metadata is detected by ownership reconciliation and removed or adopted only with a matching Machine incarnation
barriers.rollback_assertion: removing 0.4 leaves no vz-managed context; unrelated user contexts in the same config dir are byte-identical

barriers.pre_state: legacy single shared Docker credential store; no per-Machine credential scope
barriers.post_state: credentials materialized only inside the owning Machine's Docker config scope; no credential copied into another Machine or Environment
barriers.failure_injection: crash during credential materialization after the scope directory is created and before the credential file is fsync'd
barriers.expected_failure_state: partial credential file absent or unreadable by other scopes; re-materialization is idempotent
barriers.rollback_assertion: uninstall removes vz-owned credential materializations only; user Docker credentials untouched and no canary value appears in evidence
